تزدردن (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِدْنَ (tazdaridna) /taz.da.rid.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# تُزْدَرَدْنَ (tuzdaradna) /tuz.da.rad.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
